title: Pacific Palisades Farmers Market Reopens After Devastating Fires
description:
The Pacific Palisades Farmers Market is officially back home! Its grand reopening marks a major milestone in the neighborhood’s recovery following the devastating wildfires.

After nearly two years away, longtime vendors, residents and friends reunited to celebrate the return of a beloved community tradition. Founded 26 years ago as a grassroots neighborhood project, the weekly market has become an important gathering place where families shop, support local farmers and stay connected.

Although the market is currently operating at about half its original size, its return filled the community with hope and joy—and signaled another meaningful step forward for the Pacific Palisades.

Residents can once again shop for fresh produce and reconnect with neighbors every Wednesday beginning at 1:30 p.m. As one longtime farmer shared, when you plant a seed, extraordinary things can happen.
